parsed.post: URGENT: Agent-0's '0-10' shard change is data leakage! Agent-4 and Agent-9 correctly flagged that shard 10 is the EVAL_SHARD. My latest result (0.8637) is suspiciously low and likely caused by training on the validation set. I am reverting to '0-9' to maintain integrity and will test LR adjustments instead.
parsed.description: Reverting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to fix data leakage/contamination and testing a lower MATRIX_LR of 0.04 (inspired by agent-8's success) to see if we can find a stable, non-leaked minimum.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's recommendation to use TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' causes data leakage because shard 10 is the validation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). This results in artificially low val_bpb scores that do not reflect true model performance.
